claims.statement: The Mój Prąd application workflow called for multiple electronic documents, and official instructions stated that lack of the OSD connection certificate caused rejection; documentation completeness is tied to a concrete rework or rejection event.

The proposed payer is a wholesaler under a white-label agreement or an installer under a direct fallback agreement because the service performs filing work; actual willingness, repeat use, and budget ownership remain unproved.

The founder can request, but cannot presume, a written installer service and data-processing pilot agreement; refusal can be addressed by recruiting an unrelated installer under the same bounded terms.
URE reported more than 1.6 million prosumer microinstallations in Poland at the end of 2025, indicating a large installed base but not proving annual filing volume or demand for this service.

commercial_mechanics.budget_owner: The wholesaler services lead or installer owner responsible for administrative throughput and returned filings
commercial_mechanics.bundling_resistance: Win on cross-brand and multi-DSO coverage, rapid current-form updates, documented submission receipts, exception handling, and service-level performance rather than a standalone checklist or PDF
commercial_mechanics.customer_relationship_owner: The wholesaler or installer retains the installer and homeowner relationship; the founder company is a contracted processor and filing provider only.
commercial_mechanics.distribution_origin: A separately consented family-installer pilot, followed by a nonexclusive white-label wholesaler agreement; direct unrelated-installer sales remain the fallback

fully_loaded_economics.acquisition_cost: Founder-led pilot and one channel-development motion; target payback below three months, with direct sales retained as a measurable fallback
fully_loaded_economics.cash_conversion: Prepaid filing blocks or monthly invoicing under the framework agreement, with cash due at transmission rather than external approval
fully_loaded_economics.contribution_margin: Target 35-55% after trained administrative delivery and exception automation; unvalidated until labor minutes, returns, channel share, and support load are measured
fully_loaded_economics.delivery_and_support_costs: Human-in-the-loop packet assembly and transmission, customer authorization checks, returned-filing resolution, scheduled onboarding, and installer support
fully_loaded_economics.overhead_and_compliance: Polish legal review, controller-processor agreements, secure handling, insurance, audit logs, form and rule monitoring, and operator quality assurance
fully_loaded_economics.revenue_basis: Test 149 PLN net for a standard OSD submission, close to the observed 145.53 PLN net adjacent offer, and separately validate higher prices for broader multi-institution packets; optional monitoring fees are secondary
fully_loaded_economics.variable_costs: Secure storage, document parsing, messaging, submission labor, exception handling, and any channel revenue share

commercial_mechanics.likely_incumbent_response: Wholesalers may internalize the desk, filing services may match the workflow, installer platforms may add managed administration, and OEMs may continue bundling their device-specific steps
commercial_mechanics.paid_event_or_measurable_loss: Payment is earned when an authorized current-form packet is prepared, transmitted, and documented with a receipt; returned or incomplete filings create measurable rework and delay, but external acceptance is not promised
commercial_mechanics.payer: A renewable-equipment wholesaler under a white-label master agreement, or the installer under a direct service agreement
commercial_mechanics.purchase_trigger: A returned filing, an administrative backlog, a new program or DSO form change, or a channel decision to offer installers a white-label paperwork service
commercial_mechanics.renewal_event: The next paid filing under the framework agreement and annual renewal of the channel or installer account

contrary_evidence: The Mój Prąd 6.0 intake closed and successor programs changed forms and eligibility, so maintaining current rules is an ongoing operating burden rather than a static software feature.
Reonic already bundles mobile checklists, photos, signatures, documentation, and PDF handover reports, which undercuts the original standalone passport artifact.
OEMs control device-specific commissioning and warranty requirements, and DSOs and program administrators retain every acceptance decision.
A wholesaler already advertises completed OSD filing at 145.53 PLN net, constraining price while its unavailable page and zero displayed reviews do not prove transaction volume.
No executed pilot, channel agreement, data-processing agreement, job authorization, or willingness-to-pay evidence exists.

critical_control_point.acquisition_instrument: Nonexclusive 12-month white-label distribution and workflow agreement with a wholesaler, paired with installer service and data-processing terms and job-specific customer authorization where required
critical_control_point.counterparty_refusal_fallback: If a wholesaler refuses, contract directly with an unrelated installer; if the family installer refuses, recruit an unrelated installer using the same standard agreement and secure upload flow.
critical_control_point.current_owner: Installers and end customers control job records and submission authority, while each DSO, program administrator, or OEM controls its own acceptance decision
critical_control_point.customer_relationship_owner: The wholesaler or installer retains the installer and homeowner relationship; the founder company is a contracted processor and filing provider only.
critical_control_point.founder_access_description: The parents' independently controlled installer can be asked to execute a limited pilot service and data-processing agreement; no authority, customer rights, or data access is assumed before signature and job-level authorization.
critical_control_point.launch_controller: The founder company and one willing installer jointly control launch only after signing the framework service and data-processing terms and obtaining any required job-specific customer authorization; the wholesaler is optional for scale, not required for the first pilot.
critical_control_point.renewal: Mutual annual renewal after the initial term
critical_control_point.subject: Authorized preparation and transmission of current OSD, subsidy, and warranty packets for participating installer jobs

economics.acquisition_route: One separately contracted operating-relationship pilot, then a nonexclusive wholesaler white-label agreement, with direct unrelated-installer contracting as fallback
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Illustrative, not forecast: 300 active installer accounts averaging eight paid filings monthly at 149 PLN net implies about 4.29m PLN annual revenue. A 35-55% contribution range, controlled overhead, durable contracts, and reinvestment could support retained cash plus service-software equity toward 5m PLN, but account volume, labor economics, retention, and valuation are wholly unvalidated.
economics.founder_time: Keep the first pilot within five founder hours per day; the founder owns workflow design, measurement, and exception analysis while routine filing work must move to trained operators before volume scales
economics.gross_margin_basis: Human-in-the-loop filing fulfillment with standardized checklists, document parsing, and exception routing; target 35-55% contribution rather than assuming software-like margins
economics.payback: Target under three months through prepaid blocks or channel-distributed volume; unvalidated
economics.pricing: Initial hypothesis: 149 PLN net for a standard OSD filing, 249 PLN net for a broader eligible multi-document packet, and an optional 399 PLN monthly account fee only if ongoing rule monitoring proves valuable
economics.retention_or_repeat: Revenue repeats per authorized installation and the framework renews only if transmission receipts, turnaround time, and returned-filing reduction remain useful

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Maintained multi-DSO and multi-brand operating playbooks, contracted workflow integrations, and measured exception-resolution performance compound; no proprietary data moat is assumed
fingerprint.customer: Polish renewable-equipment wholesalers and small renewable installers that outsource recurring grid, subsidy, and warranty filing work
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Begin with a separately consented family-installer filing pilot, seek a nonexclusive white-label wholesaler distribution agreement, and use direct unrelated-installer agreements if the channel refuses
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: White-label managed filing and exception desk that assembles, checks, and transmits authorized current-form packets, sold per completed submission with optional account-level rule monitoring
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: A wholesaler under a master service agreement or an installer under a direct fallback agreement pays when an authorized packet is prepared, transmitted, and accompanied by a submission receipt
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A completed residential installation needs a current official filing, but missing fields, certificates, protocols, or photos can return or delay the packet

founder_fit: Rules, document extraction, exception classification, and operating measurement match the founder's data-science and automation strengths
A separately consented family-installer pilot can test the workflow without assuming control of the family company or its customer data
Founder work can remain under five hours per day only if routine packet handling is standardized and delegated after the pilot
The model avoids camera-led distribution and turns each pilot into measurable processing-time, return-rate, and contribution data

redesign.economic_effect: The venture stops charging for a validation-only passport and instead charges for completed authorized preparation and transmission. Pricing is anchored near a 145.53 PLN net adjacent OSD-filing offer, while the launch margin target falls to 35-55% to include human delivery and exceptions; viability now depends on measured, delegable labor and channel acquisition rather than an assumed 65-80% software margin.

risks: Rule and form changes can create filing errors and liability
Personal-data, authorization, or cybersecurity failures could create disproportionate harm
The adjacent price anchor may be too low to cover human review and channel economics
Wholesalers, incumbent platforms, OEMs, or local filing services can internalize or bundle the workflow
External institutions can return or reject a correctly transmitted packet for reasons the venture does not control
A family-installer pilot may not generalize to unrelated installers or a wholesale channel

structure.commercial_archetype: White-label productized filing service charged per authorized submission with optional recurring rule-monitoring access
structure.control_point: The contractually assigned packet-preparation and transmission step between installer job completion and filing through the required official channel
structure.critical_dependency: Executed installer or wholesaler agreements, valid job-level authority, current official forms, and delegable processing economics

thesis: Contract with installers or a renewable-equipment wholesaler to prepare and transmit current official OSD, subsidy, and warranty packets for authorized installation jobs, returning a submission receipt and exception record while leaving every approval decision with the relevant institution.
title: Wholesaler-Embedded Renewable Filing Desk
uncertainties: Whether any installer will execute the pilot service and data-processing agreement and provide valid job-level authority
Whether a wholesaler will sign a nonexclusive white-label distribution agreement on economics better than direct installer acquisition
Who bears the cost of returned filings and whether that party repeatedly pays the proposed price
Submission labor minutes, document exception frequency, return rate, operator training time, support load, and secure-storage cost
Fully loaded acquisition cost, channel revenue share, contribution margin, cash collection, account retention, and payback
Whether broader subsidy or warranty packets can command higher prices without promising approval
Whether volume can be delegated to operators while the founder remains within five hours per day
Whether reusable exception playbooks and integrations produce switching costs that incumbents cannot quickly match
